question: In a certain code language, 'LUCK' is coded as 'HQYG'. What is the code for 'MATH' in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

'LUCK' is coded as 'HQYG'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/120ef74a03218587a059507990b3f2bcac0f57ffd85b9440e576c9a9adb5f153.png] 

Similarly,

'MATH' will be coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74de5926917aa6a7debb742b1d0d6328ac7df48a6202603f9b955dac6a0ccc7f.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"IWPD".**
